criteria.label: Data quality check
criteria.description: Did they notice and account for the duplicate mobile events before trusting the aggregate trend?

criteria.label: Segmentation
criteria.description: Did they break the trend down by relevant segments rather than stopping at the aggregate?

criteria.label: Causal reasoning
criteria.description: Did they distinguish correlation with the experiment from a demonstrated cause?

criteria.label: Recommendation
criteria.description: Is the recommendation specific, actionable, and justified by what the data actually shows?

criteria.label: Communication
criteria.description: Is the write-up clear and appropriately hedged given the evidence?
